title: Jhoola Khali Tera Menu Asghar
body:
Jhoola khali tera menu Asghar bahun tarpaway..
<<DIVIDER>>
Sani)
Godi ujar gae aay sehra ch teri maa’n di – aeh gham bara ruwaway..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Teray maran da sadma menu muka geya aay
Teray toun baad bachra cha kay dasa day kis nu – amri teri khidaway..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Masooma bhain teray rastay nu waikhdi aay
Behndi kadi zamee’n tay uth kay kaddi Sakina – khaimay day dar tay jaway..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Umat nay pyas teri baysheer na bujhaee
Aa jaway’n jay tu murr kay ashkaa’n day naal teri – maa’n pyas nu bujhaway..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Zainab day kol beh kay Umme Rubab akhay
Bibi judaee odi mamta tay meri bann wich – khanjar pae chalaway..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Jhoolay day nal Asghar aasaa’n vi jal gaeyaan nay
Chadar wi sir toun leh gae umat nabi di sanu – rasiyan pae pawaway..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Safraan Ch wayn ker kay Abid nu akhdi si
Lawaa’n main naal gal day jay laash odi zalim- naizay utto lahaway..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Mohsin di aeh dua aay Shah da nazool howay
Choda so saal pehlay vichray putar tay maa’n nu – oh aan kay milaway..
